## Datasets

The table below lists the data files available in this repository. Click a file name to download it directly.

| File | Description | Format | Download |
|---|---|---|---|
| `example_data.csv` | Placeholder example file — replace this row (and the file in `data/`) with your real data. | CSV | [download](data/example_data.csv) |

**To add a new dataset:**

1. Put the file in the `data/` folder in the repository.
2. Add a row to the table above with its name, a short description, and a link written as `[download](data/your_file.csv)`.
3. Commit (or use the **Edit this page** link at the bottom of this page) — the site rebuilds and republishes itself automatically.
